label: Now Developing
items: The Senate impeachment court voted 13–1 on September 23 to compute Sara Duterte’s conviction threshold from senators able to take part, rather than a fixed 16 of 24.
ADB cut its 2026 Philippine growth forecast to 3.3%; Metro Manila’s ₱60 daily minimum-wage increase took effect September 26.
Rodrigo Duterte’s ICC lawyers asked on September 25 to cap disclosed evidence at 10,000 items ahead of a November 30 trial.
